name: Navratan Korma
blurb: Mixed vegetables, paneer and a few raisins in a mild cashew gravy.

steps.text: Soak the cashews in hot water and blend them smooth.
Boil the vegetables until just tender.
Soften the onions in ghee; add ginger-garlic paste, cardamom, turmeric and korma masala.
Add the cashew paste and a cup of water, then the vegetables, paneer and raisins. Simmer.
Stir in the cream and kasuri methi and serve.

name: Paneer Tikka Masala
blurb: Charred paneer tikka finished in a smoky tomato and onion masala.

steps.text: Coat the paneer, capsicum and one onion in yogurt, half the tikka masala and chilli powder. Rest 20 minutes.
Grill or pan-sear until charred at the edges.
Cook the other onion, ginger-garlic paste, tomatoes and cashews; blend smooth.
Simmer the gravy with the rest of the masala, add the tikka, cream, kasuri methi and garam masala.

name: Paneer Bhurji
blurb: Crumbled paneer cooked fast with onion, tomato and spices. Good with roti or in a pav.

steps.text: Crackle the cumin in butter, then soften the onion, ginger and chillies.
Add the tomatoes, turmeric, chilli powder and salt; cook until soft.
Crumble in the paneer, add garam masala and kasuri methi, and toss for two minutes.
Finish with coriander.

name: Aloo Matar
blurb: Potatoes and peas in a thin tomato gravy, the way most homes make it on a weeknight.

steps.text: Crackle the cumin; soften the onion, ginger and chillies.
Add the tomatoes and spices; cook until the oil separates.
Add the cubed potatoes, peas and two cups of water. Cover and simmer until the potatoes are soft.
Finish with garam masala and coriander.

name: Jeera Aloo
blurb: Boiled potatoes tossed with plenty of cumin, chilli and amchur. Five minutes once the potatoes are cooked.

steps.text: Boil the potatoes, peel and cube them.
Crackle the cumin and hing in oil, add the chillies, then the spices.
Toss in the potatoes with salt and amchur until they catch at the edges.
Finish with coriander.

name: Mushroom Masala
blurb: Mushrooms in an onion and tomato masala with a little kasuri methi.

steps.text: Sear the sliced mushrooms in a hot pan until their water cooks off. Set aside.
Crackle the cumin; brown the onions, add ginger-garlic paste.
Add the tomatoes, turmeric, chilli powder and kadai masala; cook down.
Return the mushrooms with a splash of water, add kasuri methi and coriander.

name: Mixed Veg Curry
blurb: Carrots, beans, peas and potatoes in a spiced tomato gravy.

steps.text: Crackle the cumin; soften the onions and ginger-garlic paste.
Add the tomatoes and spices; cook until thick.
Add the vegetables and a cup of water. Cover and cook until tender.
Stir in kasuri methi and coriander.

name: Lauki Kofta
blurb: Soft bottle gourd and besan dumplings in an onion and tomato gravy.

steps.text: Grate the gourd and squeeze out the water; keep the water.
Mix the gourd with besan, chillies, salt and half the spices. Shape small balls and fry until golden.
Fry the onions, ginger-garlic paste and tomatoes with the rest of the spices; blend smooth.
Simmer the gravy with the gourd water, add cream, and drop in the koftas just before serving.

name: Chicken Do Pyaza
blurb: Chicken cooked with onions twice: melted into the gravy, then added in big pieces at the end.

steps.text: Cut two onions into petals and sear them in a hot pan. Set aside.
Crackle the cumin and whole spices; brown the other two onions, sliced.
Add ginger-garlic paste, the chicken, powders and tomatoes; cook on high.
Stir in yogurt, cover and cook until the chicken is done.
Add the onion petals and garam masala; cook two minutes more.

name: Kadai Chicken
blurb: Chicken with capsicum and freshly crushed kadai spices, cooked hot in a wok.

steps.text: Dry roast the coriander seeds and chillies, then crush them coarsely.
Brown the onions, add ginger-garlic paste and the chicken; sear well.
Add the tomatoes, turmeric, kadai masala and half the crushed spice. Cover and cook.
Toss in the capsicum and the rest of the spice; cook on high for three minutes.
Finish with kasuri methi and coriander.

name: Chicken Jalfrezi
blurb: A quick, dry stir-fry of chicken, peppers and onion with tomato.

steps.text: Sear the chicken strips with ginger-garlic paste, turmeric and chilli powder.
Add the cumin, then the onion and capsicum in big pieces; toss on high heat.
Add the tomatoes, coriander powder and chillies; cook until the chicken is done and coated.
Finish with garam masala.

name: Chicken Changezi
blurb: Old Delhi's tandoori-style chicken simmered in a creamy cashew and tomato gravy.

steps.text: Marinate the chicken in yogurt, tandoori masala, chilli powder and ginger-garlic paste for an hour.
Sear or grill the chicken until charred.
Cook the onions, tomatoes and cashews until soft; blend smooth.
Simmer the gravy with cardamom and butter, add the chicken, cream, kasuri methi and garam masala.

name: Dal Fry
blurb: Toor dal cooked soft, then fried with onion, tomato and spices. Thicker than dal tadka.

steps.text: Pressure cook the dal with turmeric and three cups of water until soft.
Crackle the cumin and hing in ghee; soften the onion, ginger-garlic paste and chillies.
Add the tomatoes and chilli powder; cook down.
Pour in the dal, simmer to the thickness you like, finish with garam masala and coriander.

name: Dal Palak
blurb: Moong or toor dal with chopped spinach and a garlic tadka.

steps.text: Cook the dal with turmeric until soft.
Fry the cumin, dried chillies, hing and sliced garlic in ghee; add the onion and tomato.
Add the spinach and cook until it wilts.
Stir in the dal, simmer five minutes and finish with garam masala.

name: Egg Biryani
blurb: Boiled eggs roasted in masala and layered with basmati, mint and fried onions.

steps.text: Soak the rice for 30 minutes and the saffron in warm milk. Boil and peel the eggs.
Cook the onions, ginger-garlic paste, tomatoes, yogurt and biryani masala into a thick masala; roll the scored eggs in it.
Boil the rice with the whole spices and bay leaves until 70% done. Drain.
Layer the rice over the egg masala with mint, fried onions, saffron milk and ghee.
Cover tightly and cook on the lowest heat.

name: Kolkata Biryani
blurb: Lightly spiced mutton biryani with the potato and boiled egg Kolkata is known for.

steps.text: Marinate the mutton in yogurt, ginger-garlic paste and biryani masala for an hour. Soak the rice.
Cook the mutton in ghee until tender. Fry the potatoes golden and add them with the boiled eggs.
Boil the rice with the whole spices until 70% done. Drain.
Layer the rice over the mutton, potatoes and eggs; add saffron milk, nutmeg, kewra, fried onions and ghee.
Seal and cook on the lowest heat.

name: Thalassery Biryani
blurb: Malabar chicken biryani made with short-grain jeerakasala rice, cashews and raisins.

steps.text: Fry the cashews and raisins in ghee. Set aside.
Cook the onions, ginger-garlic paste, chillies, tomatoes and biryani masala; add the chicken and yogurt and cook until done.
Fry the rice in ghee with the whole spices and fennel, then cook it in twice its water until just done.
Layer the rice over the chicken with mint, coriander, fried onions, cashews and raisins.
Seal and cook on low heat.

name: Ambur Biryani
blurb: Tamil Nadu's chicken biryani coloured with dried red chilli paste, cooked with seeraga samba rice.

steps.text: Soak the chillies in hot water and grind them to a paste. Soak the rice.
Fry the whole spices and onions; add ginger-garlic paste, chilli paste and tomatoes and cook down.
Add the chicken, yogurt, mint and coriander; cook until nearly done.
Add the drained rice and water (1½ times the rice), salt and lemon. Cook covered on low until done.

name: Tehri
blurb: Rice cooked with potatoes, peas and whole spices in one pot. UP's everyday vegetable pulao.

steps.text: Soak the rice for 30 minutes.
Fry the cumin and whole spices in ghee; add the onion, ginger and tomato.
Add the vegetables and powders; stir for three minutes.
Add the rice and three cups of water. Cover and cook on low until done.

name: Chicken Kolhapuri
blurb: Hot Kolhapur chicken curry with roasted coconut, sesame and dried chillies.

steps.text: Dry roast the coconut, sesame, poppy seeds and chillies; fry one sliced onion; grind together with water.
Brown the other onion, add ginger-garlic paste, the chicken and turmeric; sear.
Add the tomatoes, Kolhapuri masala and the ground paste. Cover and cook until done.
Thin with water to the consistency you like; finish with coriander.
